en.setting: The server farm occupies four sublevels beneath a transit hub, where cooling fans run constantly and the air tastes of ozone. Above, the neon market flickers under ventilation gaps. Below, data vaults and neural labs hum behind biometric locks, and a scheduled grid reset at 02:00 plunges everything into twelve minutes of darkness.
en.crime: Yuki Tanaka, a neural calibration technician, was found at her station on sublevel two. Her neural port was open, her implant partially wiped, and forty-eight hours of her memory had been erased by a targeted exploit.

suspects.name: Kessler Vane
suspects.intro: A developer whose neural log shows a three-hour gap and whose compiler signature appears on the exploit code.

suspects.name: Rina Cade
suspects.intro: Runs the neural calibration lab with access to every implant in the district, her visor cracked across the left lens.

suspects.name: Marshal Cross
suspects.intro: Maintains cooling systems with a master access badge, his shift log showing a fourteen-minute gap.

suspects.name: Juno Park
suspects.intro: Data recovery specialist who visited the vault six times that month, claiming standard integrity checks.

suspects.name: Dex Millard
suspects.intro: Black-market firmware dealer whose visor was found on the transit corridor floor after the blackout.

suspects.name: Overseer Lang
suspects.intro: Controls power grid allocation for the district, his authorization required for any planned outage.

suspects.name: Ada Strand
suspects.intro: Contract analyst with surveillance feed clearance, carrying an encrypted personal chip containing suspicious metadata.

es.setting: La granja de servidores ocupa cuatro subniveles bajo un nodo de transito, donde los ventiladores de refrigeracion funcionan constantemente y el aire sabe a ozono. Arriba, el mercado de neon parpadea bajo los huecos de ventilacion. Abajo, bovedas de datos y laboratorios neuronales zumban detras de cerraduras biometricas, y un reinicio programado de la red a las 02:00 sumerge todo en doce minutos de oscuridad.
es.crime: Yuki Tanaka, tecnica de calibracion neuronal, fue encontrada en su estacion en el subnivel dos. Su puerto neuronal estaba abierto, su implante parcialmente borrado, y cuarenta y ocho horas de su memoria habian sido eliminadas por un exploit dirigido.

suspects.name: Kessler Vane
suspects.intro: Un desarrollador cuyo registro neuronal muestra un vacio de tres horas y cuya firma de compilador aparece en el codigo del exploit.

suspects.name: Rina Cade
suspects.intro: Dirige el laboratorio de calibracion neuronal con acceso a cada implante del distrito, su visor agrietado en la lente izquierda.

suspects.name: Marshal Cross
suspects.intro: Mantiene los sistemas de refrigeracion con una credencial de acceso maestro, su registro de turno mostrando un vacio de catorce minutos.

suspects.name: Juno Park
suspects.intro: Especialista en recuperacion de datos que visito la boveda seis veces ese mes, alegando verificaciones de integridad estandar.

suspects.name: Dex Millard
suspects.intro: Traficante de firmware del mercado negro cuyo visor fue encontrado en el suelo del corredor de transito tras el apagon.

suspects.name: Supervisor Lang
suspects.intro: Controla la asignacion de la red electrica del distrito, su autorizacion requerida para cualquier corte planificado.

suspects.name: Ada Strand
suspects.intro: Analista contratada con autorizacion para feeds de vigilancia, portando un chip personal encriptado con metadatos sospechosos.

fr.setting: La ferme de serveurs occupe quatre sous-niveaux sous un hub de transit, ou les ventilateurs de refroidissement tournent en permanence et l'air a un gout d'ozone. Au-dessus, le marche neon scintille sous les bouches d'aeration. En dessous, des coffres de donnees et des laboratoires neuronaux bourdonnent derriere des verrous biometriques, et une reinitialisation programmee du reseau a 02h00 plonge tout dans douze minutes d'obscurite.
fr.crime: Yuki Tanaka, technicienne de calibration neuronale, a ete retrouvee a son poste au sous-niveau deux. Son port neural etait ouvert, son implant partiellement efface, et quarante-huit heures de sa memoire avaient ete supprimees par un exploit cible.

suspects.name: Kessler Vane
suspects.intro: Un developpeur dont le journal neural montre un trou de trois heures et dont la signature de compilateur apparait sur le code de l'exploit.

suspects.name: Rina Cade
suspects.intro: Dirige le laboratoire de calibration neuronale avec acces a chaque implant du district, son viseur fissure sur la lentille gauche.

suspects.name: Marshal Cross
suspects.intro: Maintient les systemes de refroidissement avec un badge d'acces maitre, son journal de service montrant un trou de quatorze minutes.

suspects.name: Juno Park
suspects.intro: Specialiste en recuperation de donnees ayant visite le coffre six fois ce mois-ci, pretextant des verifications d'integrite standard.

suspects.name: Dex Millard
suspects.intro: Revendeur de firmware au marche noir dont le viseur a ete trouve sur le sol du couloir de transit apres la panne.

suspects.name: Superviseur Lang
suspects.intro: Controle l'allocation du reseau electrique du district, son autorisation requise pour toute coupure planifiee.

suspects.name: Ada Strand
suspects.intro: Analyste contractuelle avec autorisation d'acces aux flux de surveillance, portant une puce personnelle chiffree contenant des metadonnees suspectes.

physical_evidence.en: The compiler signature on the exploit code matched Vane's developer credentials. A private node behind the cooling bay panel connected to his uplink, and the power spike at 02:14 matched the forced neural purge to the millisecond. Tanaka's neural port was open and her implant partially wiped.
physical_evidence.es: La firma del compilador en el codigo del exploit coincidia con las credenciales de desarrollador de Vane. Un nodo privado detras del panel de la bahia de refrigeracion se conectaba a su enlace ascendente, y el pico de potencia a las 02:14 coincidia con la purga neuronal forzada al milisegundo. El puerto neuronal de Tanaka estaba abierto y su implante parcialmente borrado.
physical_evidence.fr: La signature du compilateur sur le code de l'exploit correspondait aux identifiants de developpeur de Vane. Un noeud prive derriere le panneau de la baie de refroidissement se connectait a sa liaison montante, et le pic de puissance a 02h14 correspondait a la purge neuronale forcee a la milliseconde pres. Le port neural de Tanaka etait ouvert et son implant partiellement efface.

witness_testimony.en: Marshal Cross's shift log showed a fourteen-minute gap during the blackout. Rina Cade confirmed access to every implant in the district from her neural calibration lab. Dex Millard's visor was found on the transit corridor floor, and he could not account for the twelve minutes of darkness.
witness_testimony.es: El registro de turno de Marshal Cross mostraba un vacio de catorce minutos durante el apagon. Rina Cade confirmo acceso a cada implante del distrito desde su laboratorio de calibracion neuronal. El visor de Dex Millard fue encontrado en el suelo del corredor de transito, y no pudo justificar los doce minutos de oscuridad.
witness_testimony.fr: Le journal de service de Marshal Cross montrait un trou de quatorze minutes pendant la panne. Rina Cade a confirme l'acces a chaque implant du district depuis son laboratoire de calibration neuronale. Le viseur de Dex Millard a ete trouve sur le sol du couloir de transit, et il n'a pu justifier les douze minutes d'obscurite.

financial_trail.en: The surveillance backdoor contract was brokered through an encrypted channel that Vane's personal chip could decrypt. Ada Strand's chip contained metadata linking to the private buyer, but the routing pointed through Vane's uplink node. Tanaka had flagged the surveillance routing for review the day before she was wiped.
financial_trail.es: El contrato de la puerta trasera de vigilancia fue negociado a traves de un canal encriptado que el chip personal de Vane podia descifrar. El chip de Ada Strand contenia metadatos vinculados al comprador privado, pero el enrutamiento pasaba por el nodo de enlace de Vane. Tanaka habia marcado el enrutamiento de vigilancia para revision el dia antes de ser borrada.
financial_trail.fr: Le contrat de la porte derobee de surveillance a ete negocie par un canal chiffre que la puce personnelle de Vane pouvait dechiffrer. La puce d'Ada Strand contenait des metadonnees menant a l'acheteur prive, mais le routage passait par le noeud de liaison de Vane. Tanaka avait signale le routage de surveillance pour examen la veille de son effacement.

emotional_tells.en: Vane's neural log showed a three-hour gap he could not explain. Overseer Lang authorized the planned outage without questioning the timing. Juno Park visited the data vault six times that month, each visit longer than the last, and her recovery reports grew shorter.
emotional_tells.es: El registro neuronal de Vane mostraba un vacio de tres horas que no pudo explicar. El Supervisor Lang autorizo el corte planificado sin cuestionar el momento. Juno Park visito la boveda de datos seis veces ese mes, cada visita mas larga que la anterior, y sus informes de recuperacion se acortaron.
emotional_tells.fr: Le journal neural de Vane montrait un trou de trois heures qu'il ne pouvait expliquer. Le Superviseur Lang a autorise la coupure planifiee sans questionner le moment. Juno Park a visite le coffre de donnees six fois ce mois-la, chaque visite plus longue que la precedente, et ses rapports de recuperation se sont raccourcis.

cold_case_physical.en: The access logs were overwritten in the next maintenance cycle. The private node was dismantled before anyone checked behind the cooling bay panel. Tanaka's neural implant was catalogued and shelved in an evidence locker that lost power twice a year.
cold_case_physical.es: Los registros de acceso fueron sobrescritos en el siguiente ciclo de mantenimiento. El nodo privado fue desmantelado antes de que nadie revisara detras del panel de la bahia de refrigeracion. El implante neuronal de Tanaka fue catalogado y guardado en un deposito de pruebas que perdia energia dos veces al ano.
cold_case_physical.fr: Les journaux d'acces ont ete ecrases lors du prochain cycle de maintenance. Le noeud prive a ete demonte avant que quiconque ne verifie derriere le panneau de la baie de refroidissement. L'implant neural de Tanaka a ete catalogue et range dans un casier a preuves qui perdait l'alimentation deux fois par an.

cold_case_financial.en: The security audit was postponed, then cancelled. The surveillance data continued to flow through channels that no one was watching. The backdoor contract was fulfilled, the private buyer paid, and Kessler Vane's uplink node hummed on beneath the neon market without interruption.
cold_case_financial.es: La auditoria de seguridad fue pospuesta, luego cancelada. Los datos de vigilancia continuaron fluyendo por canales que ya nadie vigilaba. El contrato de la puerta trasera fue cumplido, el comprador privado pago, y el nodo de enlace de Kessler Vane siguio zumbando bajo el mercado de neon sin interrupcion.
cold_case_financial.fr: L'audit de securite a ete reporte, puis annule. Les donnees de surveillance ont continue de circuler par des canaux que plus personne ne surveillait. Le contrat de la porte derobee a ete rempli, l'acheteur prive a paye, et le noeud de liaison de Kessler Vane a continue de bourdonner sous le marche neon sans interruption.

all_strong.en: Kessler Vane had built the backdoor, brokered the contract, and killed the one person whose audit would have exposed everything. The compiler signature on the exploit was his, the private node behind the cooling bay panel connected to his uplink, and the power spike at 02:14 matched the forced neural purge to the millisecond. Tanaka had found the surveillance routing and flagged it for review. Vane erased her memory and her life in the same twelve-minute window. The neon market buzzed on above, oblivious. Below, the data told everything.
all_strong.es: Kessler Vane habia construido la puerta trasera, negociado el contrato y matado a la unica persona cuya auditoria habria expuesto todo. La firma del compilador en el exploit era suya, el nodo privado detras del panel de la bahia de refrigeracion se conectaba a su enlace ascendente, y el pico de potencia a las 02:14 coincidia con la purga neuronal forzada al milisegundo. Tanaka habia encontrado el enrutamiento de vigilancia y lo habia marcado para revision. Vane borro su memoria y su vida en la misma ventana de doce minutos. El mercado de neon zumbaba arriba, ajeno. Abajo, los datos lo contaban todo.
all_strong.fr: Kessler Vane avait construit la porte derobee, negocie le contrat et tue la seule personne dont l'audit aurait tout revele. La signature du compilateur sur l'exploit etait la sienne, le noeud prive derriere le panneau de la baie de refroidissement se connectait a sa liaison montante, et le pic de puissance a 02h14 correspondait a la purge neuronale forcee a la milliseconde pres. Tanaka avait decouvert le routage de surveillance et l'avait signale pour examen. Vane a efface sa memoire et sa vie dans la meme fenetre de douze minutes. Le marche neon bourdonnait au-dessus, inconscient. En dessous, les donnees disaient tout.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Vane's name surfaced from the access logs and the compiler signature, but the digital trail was as fragmented as Tanaka's wiped memory. The exploit code pointed one way, the encrypted communications another, and the surveillance feed loop covered the crucial minutes in recycled footage. He was flagged, detained, and charged on the weight of his name in the system. The conviction relied on metadata where it needed machine-readable proof.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: El nombre de Vane surgio de los registros de acceso y la firma del compilador, pero el rastro digital estaba tan fragmentado como la memoria borrada de Tanaka. El codigo del exploit senalaba en una direccion, las comunicaciones encriptadas en otra, y el bucle del feed de vigilancia cubria los minutos cruciales con metraje reciclado. Fue senalado, detenido y acusado por el peso de su nombre en el sistema. La condena se apoyo en metadatos donde necesitaba pruebas legibles por maquina.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Le nom de Vane est apparu des journaux d'acces et de la signature du compilateur, mais la piste numerique etait aussi fragmentee que la memoire effacee de Tanaka. Le code de l'exploit pointait dans une direction, les communications chiffrees dans une autre, et la boucle du flux de surveillance couvrait les minutes cruciales avec des images recyclees. Il a ete signale, detenu et inculpe sur le poids de son nom dans le systeme. La condamnation reposait sur des metadonnees la ou il fallait des preuves lisibles par machine.

wrong_accusation.en: The encrypted chip planted in Ada Strand's storage did its job perfectly. She was detained, her clearance revoked, and Kessler Vane continued his contract with the private buyer without interruption. The surveillance backdoor remained active, the data flowed, and Yuki Tanaka's wiped memory became just another maintenance anomaly in a system that generated thousands. The neon market flickered on, and the real killer walked its corridors in plain sight.
wrong_accusation.es: El chip encriptado plantado en el almacenamiento de Ada Strand cumplio su funcion perfectamente. Fue detenida, su autorizacion revocada, y Kessler Vane continuo su contrato con el comprador privado sin interrupcion. La puerta trasera de vigilancia permanecio activa, los datos fluyeron, y la memoria borrada de Yuki Tanaka se convirtio en otra anomalia de mantenimiento en un sistema que generaba miles. El mercado de neon siguio parpadeando, y el verdadero asesino caminaba por sus corredores a plena vista.
wrong_accusation.fr: La puce chiffree plantee dans le stockage d'Ada Strand a parfaitement rempli son role. Elle a ete detenue, son habilitation revoquee, et Kessler Vane a poursuivi son contrat avec l'acheteur prive sans interruption. La porte derobee de surveillance est restee active, les donnees ont continue de circuler, et la memoire effacee de Yuki Tanaka est devenue juste une autre anomalie de maintenance dans un systeme qui en generait des milliers. Le marche neon a continue de scintiller, et le veritable tueur arpentait ses couloirs en pleine lumiere.

cold_case.en: The security audit was postponed, then cancelled, then forgotten. The access logs were overwritten in the next maintenance cycle, the private node was dismantled before anyone checked behind the panel, and Yuki Tanaka's neural implant was catalogued and shelved in an evidence locker that lost power twice a year. The server farm hummed on, the blackout window came and went every seventy-two hours, and the surveillance data continued to flow through channels that no one was watching anymore.
cold_case.es: La auditoria de seguridad fue pospuesta, luego cancelada, luego olvidada. Los registros de acceso fueron sobrescritos en el siguiente ciclo de mantenimiento, el nodo privado fue desmantelado antes de que nadie revisara detras del panel, y el implante neuronal de Yuki Tanaka fue catalogado y guardado en un deposito de pruebas que perdia energia dos veces al ano. La granja de servidores siguio zumbando, la ventana de apagon iba y venia cada setenta y dos horas, y los datos de vigilancia continuaron fluyendo por canales que ya nadie vigilaba.
cold_case.fr: L'audit de securite a ete reporte, puis annule, puis oublie. Les journaux d'acces ont ete ecrases lors du prochain cycle de maintenance, le noeud prive a ete demonte avant que quiconque ne verifie derriere le panneau, et l'implant neural de Yuki Tanaka a ete catalogue et range dans un casier a preuves qui perdait l'alimentation deux fois par an. La ferme de serveurs a continue de bourdonner, la fenetre de panne allait et venait toutes les soixante-douze heures, et les donnees de surveillance ont continue de circuler par des canaux que plus personne ne surveillait.

lucky_guess.en: Vane's name was flagged by an algorithm, not an investigator. The compiler signature matched, the timing aligned, but the chain of evidence was held together by correlation rather than causation. He was arrested on probability, convicted on pattern recognition, and the question of whether justice or statistics carried the day was one that the system preferred not to answer.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Vane fue senalado por un algoritmo, no por un investigador. La firma del compilador coincidia, el momento se alineaba, pero la cadena de pruebas se sostenia por correlacion mas que por causalidad. Fue arrestado por probabilidad, condenado por reconocimiento de patrones, y la cuestion de si la justicia o las estadisticas ganaron el dia fue una que el sistema prefirio no responder.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom de Vane a ete signale par un algorithme, pas par un enqueteur. La signature du compilateur correspondait, le timing s'alignait, mais la chaine de preuves tenait par correlation plutot que par causalite. Il a ete arrete sur probabilite, condamne par reconnaissance de motifs, et la question de savoir si c'est la justice ou les statistiques qui l'ont emporte est une question que le systeme a prefere ne pas trancher.

expressions.suspect:kessler_vane: Kessler Vane leaned against the server rack with his interface port uncovered. His neural log showed a three-hour gap where the timestamps should be.
expressions.event:memory_wipe_exploit: A targeted memory wipe erased Tanaka's last forty-eight hours of neural storage. The exploit required root access and knowledge of the implant firmware.
expressions.motive:surveillance_backdoor: Tanaka discovered a backdoor routing civilian surveillance data to a private buyer. The code signature matched a contract Vane had brokered six months earlier.
expressions.suspect:rina_cade: Rina Cade ran the neural calibration lab and had access to every implant in the district. Her visor was cracked across the left lens.
expressions.suspect:marshal_cross: Marshal Cross maintained the cooling systems and carried a master access badge. His shift log showed continuous entries except for fourteen minutes.
expressions.suspect:juno_park: Juno Park specialised in data recovery and had visited the vault six times that month. She said she was running standard integrity checks.
expressions.suspect:dex_millard: Dex Millard sold black-market firmware upgrades in the neon market. His visor was found on the transit corridor floor after the blackout.
expressions.suspect:overseer_lang: Overseer Lang controlled the power grid allocation for the district. His authorisation was required for any planned outage.
expressions.suspect:ada_strand: Ada Strand worked as a contract analyst with clearance for the surveillance feeds. Her encrypted personal chip contained files she claimed were research notes.
expressions.location:server_farm: The server farm occupies four sublevels beneath the transit hub. The cooling fans run constantly and the air tastes of ozone.
expressions.location:neural_lab: The neural lab is a clean room on sublevel two with biometric locks. Tanaka was found slumped at her calibration station with her port still open.
expressions.location:transit_corridor: The transit corridor connects the server farm to the surface levels. The overhead lights cycle off during grid resets.
expressions.location:command_deck: The command deck monitors power distribution across the district. Twelve screens display real-time grid status and access logs.
expressions.location:data_vault: The data vault stores archived surveillance feeds behind a triple-lock system. The humidity is controlled and the walls are signal-shielded.
expressions.location:cooling_bay: The cooling bay circulates fluid through the server racks at constant pressure. A stain on the floor near rack seven has not been cleaned.
expressions.location:neon_market: The neon market runs along the surface concourse under flickering signs. Rain drips through the ventilation gaps and pools on the grating.
expressions.location:private_node: The private node is an unregistered terminal behind a false panel in the cooling bay. The connection bypasses all standard monitoring.
expressions.object:neural_implant: Tanaka's neural implant was removed post-mortem and its firmware partially overwritten. The remaining code contains fragments of an unauthorised exploit.
expressions.object:access_log: The server farm access log records all badge swipes by time and level. One entry at 02:17 uses a cloned credential that does not match any staff member.
expressions.object:wipe_residue: Residual charge patterns on Tanaka's implant are consistent with a forced memory purge. The wipe was thorough but left artefacts in the boot sector.
expressions.object:backdoor_code: A code fragment recovered from the private node matches the surveillance routing exploit. The compiler signature links to Vane's registered development environment.
expressions.object:biometric_scan: The biometric scanner at the neural lab door recorded six entries between midnight and four. One scan returned a confidence score below normal threshold.
expressions.object:data_fragment: A recovered data fragment contains routing instructions for civilian surveillance feeds. The destination address is a private server registered under a shell company.
expressions.object:cooling_fluid: Cooling fluid from rack seven shows an unusual pH level. The imbalance is consistent with a foreign substance introduced through the circulation port.
expressions.object:encrypted_chip: Ada Strand's personal chip is encrypted with a military-grade algorithm. Partial decryption reveals surveillance metadata timestamped to the night of the death.
expressions.object:broken_visor: A cracked AR visor was found near the neural lab entrance. The display memory contains the last image rendered: a grid map of sublevel two.
expressions.object:power_grid_log: The power grid log shows a scheduled reset at 02:00 followed by an unscheduled spike at 02:14. The spike duration matches the exploit execution window.
expressions.object:surveillance_feed: Archived surveillance feeds for sublevel two show a four-minute loop between 02:10 and 02:14. The loop replaces live footage with a pre-recorded segment.
expressions.object:comm_transcript: A communication transcript recovered from the command deck shows an encrypted exchange at 01:55. The encryption key has not been cracked.
expressions.object:signal_trace: A signal trace from the private node shows data transmitted to an external address at 02:16. The packet size matches a full neural memory dump.
expressions.emotion:flat_affect: His voice did not modulate when shown the implant. He asked whether the firmware version had been logged.
expressions.emotion:quick_deflection: She redirected every question about the lab to the access protocols. Her hand moved to her cracked visor and stopped.
expressions.emotion:coded_language: Each response used technical jargon that obscured more than it clarified. She spoke as if giving testimony she had rehearsed.
expressions.emotion:micro_delay: There was a half-second pause before each answer about the cooling bay. His eyes tracked right before he spoke.
expressions.emotion:hollow_calm: Her tone was perfectly level throughout the interview. She did not blink when the encrypted chip was placed on the table.
expressions.emotion:forced_cooperation: He offered to open his grid logs without being asked. His hand was already on the terminal before the question was finished.
expressions.modifier:log_overwritten: The access log entry at 02:17 was overwritten with null data within six minutes. The overwrite used administrative privileges.
expressions.modifier:power_spike: The unscheduled power spike at 02:14 lasted eleven seconds. The spike profile matches a forced neural purge at maximum voltage.
expressions.modifier:signal_masked: The communication at 01:55 used frequency-hopping encryption. The signal was routed through three relay nodes to obscure its origin.
expressions.modifier:rain_static: Rain interference degraded external communications after midnight. The transit corridor cameras recorded only static during the outage window.
expressions.modifier:node_isolated: The private node was disconnected from the main network but retained a direct external uplink. The isolation was deliberate.
expressions.modifier:implant_signature: The exploit code on Tanaka's implant carries a compiler signature registered to Vane's development licence. The signature is unique to his toolchain.
expressions.modifier:coolant_stain: The coolant stain near rack seven contains traces of neural conducting gel. The gel is used only in implant calibration procedures.
expressions.modifier:visor_crack_pattern: The crack pattern on the visor radiates from a single impact point. The force is consistent with the visor being dropped, not struck.
expressions.modifier:code_remnant: A code remnant in the implant boot sector references the surveillance backdoor by its internal project name. The name appears in no public documentation.
expressions.modifier:port_scorched: The neural port housing shows micro-scorching consistent with a high-voltage forced connection. The burn pattern is directional.
expressions.action:exploit_deployed: The memory wipe exploit was deployed via direct port connection at approximately 02:12. The execution required physical access to the implant interface.
expressions.action:power_cut_staged: The power grid was reset at 02:00 to create a maintenance window. The reset masked the subsequent spike caused by the exploit.
expressions.action:vault_breached: The data vault was accessed during the blackout using cloned credentials. The triple-lock system recorded no anomaly because the clone matched at all three levels.
expressions.action:feed_looped: The surveillance feed for sublevel two was replaced with a four-minute loop. The loop was spliced from footage recorded the previous night.
expressions.action:scan_forged: A biometric scan was forged using a captured template from the access system. The confidence score was low but passed the minimum threshold.
expressions.action:chip_planted: An encrypted chip was planted in Ada Strand's personal storage without her knowledge. The chip contained surveillance metadata designed to implicate her.
expressions.action:visor_removed: A visor was dropped near the neural lab entrance during the blackout. The owner has not come forward to claim it.
expressions.action:signal_rerouted: Surveillance data was rerouted from the main archive to an external server. The rerouting occurred automatically via the backdoor code.
expressions.action:node_accessed: The private node behind the cooling bay panel was accessed between 01:50 and 02:20. The connection log shows a single session.
expressions.time:blackout_hour: The scheduled grid reset began at 02:00 and lasted twelve minutes. During this window all internal cameras and sensors were offline.
expressions.time:grid_cycle: The grid cycles through maintenance every seventy-two hours. The reset on the night of the death coincided with the standard schedule.
expressions.time:body_located: Tanaka's body was found by the maintenance bot at 06:14. The implant port was open and the calibration station was powered down.
expressions.time:access_window: The cloned credential was used between 02:10 and 02:24. No other unauthorised access was recorded in that period.
expressions.time:audit_pending: A security audit of the surveillance system was scheduled for the following week. Tanaka had flagged anomalies in the routing tables.
expressions.motive:contract_profit: Vane brokered a contract to sell surveillance access to a private intelligence firm. The contract was worth three years of his standard salary.
expressions.motive:corporate_espionage: Juno Park had been contracted by a competing firm to extract archived surveillance data. Her visits to the vault coincided with data export events.
expressions.motive:exposure_panic: Tanaka's audit would have revealed the backdoor within days. Vane had no way to remove the code without leaving a trace.
expressions.motive:rival_network: Overseer Lang was building an independent power brokerage using grid access as leverage. Tanaka's audit threatened to expose his side operations.
expressions.motive:data_ransom: Ada Strand had been approached to sell decrypted surveillance feeds on the black market. The value of a single feed exceeded her annual contract.
expressions.witness:grid_operator: The grid operator confirmed the scheduled reset at 02:00. She noted the unscheduled spike at 02:14 but attributed it to a cooling fault.
expressions.witness:courier_drone: A courier drone transiting the corridor at 01:58 recorded thermal signatures of two individuals near the neural lab entrance.
expressions.witness:maintenance_bot: The maintenance bot found Tanaka at 06:14 during its standard sweep. Its log shows no other anomalies on sublevel two.
expressions.witness:shift_analyst: The shift analyst reviewed the access log at 07:00 and flagged the cloned credential entry. She escalated it to security within the hour.
expressions.witness:vendor_ai: A vendor AI in the neon market recorded a signal burst at 02:16 consistent with a large data transmission. The source was below street level.
expressions.event:yuki_tanaka_discovered: Yuki Tanaka was found at her calibration station on sublevel two. Her neural port was open and her implant had been partially wiped.
expressions.event:grid_surge: An unscheduled power surge hit sublevel two at 02:14. The surge was contained to the neural lab circuit and lasted eleven seconds.
